kp_title: KP 1. Identifying Vector Fields That Satisfy the Unit Curl Property
raw_html:
1.?

Let C be a simple, piecewise-smooth, closed, and positively oriented curve. Given that the line integral ∮CF⋅dr represents the area of the region D enclosed by any such curve in R2, which of the following could be the vector field F(x,y)?

  1. F(x,y)=⟨0,x⟩
  2. F(x,y)=⟨ey,y⟩
  3. F(x,y)=⟨−y5+arctan⁡x,4x5⟩

kp_title: KP 2. Expressing the Area Bounded by a Closed Curve Using Green’s Theorem
raw_html:
6.?

Let D be the region enclosed by the curve C parametrized as r(t)=⟨2sin⁡t,3sin⁡2t⟩ for t∈[0,π]. The area of D can be written as

Area(D)=∬D(∂Q∂x−∂P∂y)dA=∫0πAAAAAAAdt,

where P(x,y)=0 and Q(x,y)=x. Determine the missing part of the equation.

Hint: Note that C is negatively oriented.
